title: Research: atomic triple-sum connector does not beat the universal budget (no new kappa)
head: 0c6a58aaf22e0fc1b34497f8f6f80db6212b4621
body:
## Summary

- Adds one charged alphabet symbol to Ross Richardson's universal dirty connector: an atomic `TRIO_{j,k,l}` that adds three read-only sources into `z` in one frame.
- On the universal 7-mask and 31-mask batches, every positive source-map price leaves this symbol at least two cheapest applications above the known 6-toggle and 12-toggle repairs. No frame saving survives the counting bound and the ten-call census.
- No selected-frontier, supplier, or kappa change.

## Scope

Task `connector-alphabet-change`, priority revision 2, seed `7073f19eda1a91682f62a8206ecc4836`, scope key `ff4f5113ed2256ab19ed`. Base `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Scope status: refined.

The new symbol pays `λ_j + λ_k + λ_l + f` with every `λ_j > 0` and frame price `f ≥ 0`. It does not expose partial sums. Weight-2 DUO (#1403), two-connector transfers (#1412, #1486, PR #1438), mutable sources (PR #1340 / #1370) and the same-alphabet six-source extension (PR #1185) are different objects and are not rerun.

Coordination: [discussion #1504](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1504). Overlap refresh at submission covered 759 open PRs and 193 discussions, complete pagination. The matches are the predecessor, this claim, and those neighboring alphabets.

## Evidence

Python 3.12.10 registered replay:

```text
PASS_ATOMIC_TRIO_CONNECTOR three_source_orders=24 misses={3: 8, 5: 8, 6: 8} five_source_words=6048000 full_covers=0 best_coverage=30
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/atomic-trio-connector outcome=negative-result
```

`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'` passed (20 tests, 1 skipped). The predecessor control `PASS_UNIVERSAL_CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY pairings=945 max_coverage=31 queries=74 leaves=182` was rerun. A full selected-frontier replay was not run.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/atomic-trio-connector --check-only`
- [x] Python 3.12 `scripts/research_package.py --package research/atomic-trio-connector`
- [x] Research onboarding unit tests
- [ ] Maintainer review of the price model and the census domain

## Limits

Finite exclusion of this one symbol on two batch sizes. Not a proof-assistant theorem, not a bound for every other connector alphabet, and not a new multiplication exponent.

Prepared by Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo) with substantial Cursor agent assistance. Predecessor credit remains with Ross Richardson (universal connector boundary / PR934). Apache-2.0.

Optional workflow note: task `connector-alphabet-change` / revision 2, negative result. The largest detour was a full clone of this repository, which is too large for a one-hour session; a sparse checkout was enough. One concrete improvement would be a blob-filtered contributor bootstrap in the package guide.
